name: Price OHLCV
description: Open, High, Low, Close & Volume data from exchanges. The baseline of any technical strategy.

name: Order Book & Flow
description: Real-time order book depth, bid/ask imbalance, and large order detection.

name: On-Chain Analytics
description: Blockchain data: wallet flows, exchange inflows/outflows, whale movements, HODL waves.

name: Social Sentiment
description: NLP-derived sentiment score from Twitter/X, Reddit, Discord, Telegram. -1 (bearish) to +1 (bullish).

name: Fear & Greed Index
description: Composite index (0–100) aggregating volatility, momentum, sentiment, and survey data.

name: Macro Indicators
description: Fed rates, CPI, GDP, unemployment, PMI, yield curves. Critical for macro-driven strategies.

name: GitHub Commits
description: Development activity for open-source blockchain projects. Proxy for technology health.

name: News & Events
description: Real-time financial news, earnings releases, regulatory filings, and geopolitical events.

name: DeFi Metrics
description: TVL, liquidity pools, yield rates, protocol revenues across major DeFi protocols.

name: Options Flow
description: Options open interest, put/call ratio, implied volatility, and large options block trades.

name: AI Avatar Signal
description: Opinion vector from a trained user avatar. Outputs allocation bias across asset classes.

name: Geopolitical Stress
description: Composite geopolitical risk index from conflict zones, elections, sanctions, and trade wars.
